headline: Allentown council OKs property tax hike despite opposition
summary: Allentown City Council approved a property tax increase Tuesday in a 5-2 vote. The 1.5-mill increase is the city's first since 2022 and will generate an estimated $3.4 million annually for police staffing and infrastructure.

headline: Former Bethlehem Steel site to get $12M for housing and retail
summary: A $12 million state grant will fund a mixed-use development on the former Bethlehem Steel site. Developer Peron Group says the project brings 200 apartments and 30,000 square feet of retail to the South Side riverfront.

headline: Fire breaks out at Lower Macungie warehouse; no injuries reported
summary: A fire at an Amazon distribution warehouse in Lower Macungie Township was quickly contained Wednesday morning. The fire started in a loading dock area around 4:30 a.m. and was under control by 5:15 a.m. No injuries were reported. Operations resumed by noon.

headline: Popular Emmaus bakery to close after 35 years on Main Street
summary: Breadworks Bakery on Main Street in Emmaus will close permanently at the end of April, owner Helen Gruber announced. The bakery has been a fixture in the borough since 1991. Gruber cited rising costs and the difficulty of finding staff.

headline: Phillies beat Yankees 6-3 in spring training; Harper goes 2-for-4
summary: The Philadelphia Phillies defeated the New York Yankees 6-3 in a spring training game Wednesday. Bryce Harper went 2-for-4 with a home run.

headline: Lehigh Valley Health Network breaks ground on $180M Easton campus expansion
summary: Lehigh Valley Health Network held a groundbreaking ceremony Wednesday for a $180 million expansion of its Easton campus. The project adds a new patient tower with 120 beds, a cardiac catheterization lab, and expanded emergency department capacity. Completion is expected in 2028.
